name: CLI & Entry Points
description: The three ways to launch the D455 scanner (console script via cli.py, `python -m scanner`, and the standalone root script) plus the package root that documents the overall two-phase pipeline.

name: Sensor & Camera I/O
description: Direct interfaces to the RealSense D455 hardware: the depth/color video pipeline with post-processing and exposure locking, and the IMU motion-module pipeline that primes tracking with a rotation prior.

name: Realtime Capture & Tracking
description: The live realtime capture loop (CaptureSession) that orchestrates camera and IMU acquisition, frame-to-model tracking, relocalization, and TSDF integration, along with the shared RGB-D odometry helper it relies on.

name: Offline Reconstruction Pipeline
description: Post-capture refinement of a scan: pose-graph construction and optimization with loop closure, TSDF re-integration at finer voxel resolution, and point cloud/mesh export.

name: Shared Utilities & Configuration
description: Cross-cutting support modules used by both the realtime capture path and the offline pipeline: threaded frame/metadata persistence, tuning constants, and SO(3)/SE(3) math helpers.

name: Documentation & Packaging
description: Project-level documentation and Python packaging metadata describing how to install, run, and understand the D455 scanner.

name: Tooling / Analysis Artifacts
description: Configuration and ignore-list files belonging to the Understand-Anything analysis tool itself, unrelated to the D455 scanner's own architecture.
